name: capell-app/theme-inertia-bookings
description: Premium Inertia booking-business theme for services, clinics, consultants, classes, and appointments.

healthChecks.label: Theme Inertia Bookings runtime and renderer bindings are installed.

marketplace.summary: Premium Inertia booking-business theme for services, clinics, consultants, classes, and appointments.
marketplace.description: Theme Inertia Bookings renders Capell marketing pages through Inertia and links into the real Bookings appointment request flow with lazy slot loading.

screenshots.alt: Theme Inertia Bookings marketplace card with booking-first Inertia page and request flow.
screenshots.caption: A premium Inertia theme for appointment-led service websites that need fast public pages and real booking requests.

screenshots.alt: Inertia bookings homepage with service proof, appointment action, and content sections.
screenshots.caption: The theme gives booking businesses a focused homepage structure for services, proof, locations, FAQs, and calls to action.

screenshots.alt: Inertia booking request flow with lazy slot loading and appointment form fields.
screenshots.caption: The public request route uses Capell Inertia and the Bookings package contract for live slot selection.

screenshots.alt: Inertia bookings services section with appointment-led cards, proof blocks, and calls to action.
screenshots.caption: Service sections frame consultations, classes, and clinics around the next available booking action.

screenshots.alt: Inertia bookings locations and FAQ sections with local trust content and final booking prompt.
screenshots.caption: Location and FAQ sections help visitors confirm practical details before starting a booking request.

screenshots.alt: Mobile Inertia booking request flow with labelled fields, available slots, and submit action.
screenshots.caption: The mobile request capture shows the appointment flow remains usable on narrow phone viewports.
